lessons.lesson: Data availability is not timing availability: Eurostat's keyless DATA API serves HICP values freely while the release-calendar evidence sits behind a JS app and an EU-Login wall. A bloc can be value-readable and timing-unevidenced at once; per P-1 the timing is the PIT authority, so the bloc stays OUT.
lessons.consequence: P0 probes must measure the TIMING channel separately from the VALUE channel for every series class

lessons.lesson: Official evidence discovery may use search engines as LOCATORS (ECB hash-suffixed PR URLs are underivable post-redesign), but the evidence is only the located official page's archived bytes with content verification (title + effective date + rate value). Locator provenance is never evidence.
lessons.consequence: enumerate-and-verify is the sanctioned discovery pattern; constructed URLs are assumptions, not addresses

lessons.lesson: A pinned authority's VALUES can be wrong even when its structure is append-only and sha-pinned: the V4-pinned ledger's EMU block mixes MRO and DFR series from 2023-09-20 onward. Append-only protected the bytes, not the truth; the extension adapter's content verification is what surfaced it.
lessons.consequence: every ledger upgrade must re-verify values against the primary source, not just availability; mismatches stay unevidenced and become owner debt

lessons.lesson: The falsification-by-control cluster gained a sharper instance: the SHAM calendar out-earned the anchor (+2.744 vs -2.608 expectancy) — the conditioning itself carried NEGATIVE information while generic exposure showed a whisper-positive that died at the frozen primary stress gate (PF margin +0.0468, P-2 knife-edge).
lessons.consequence: cluster instance #10; sham controls must run at identical clocks/tiers, and thin neighbour passes must be read through the primary stress gate before any survivor talk
